x.note: Liara's X travel is only 5 mm - a fifth of n7's. Taken verbatim from Liara's ScopeSettings.txt <Stage limits> (hard and soft both 0.000-5.000). Note the scope leaves NO margin of its own here, unlike n7 (soft z min 11.0 against hard 8.0), so this file is the only slack in the system.

r.note: Edit > Microscope Setup only collects x/y/z, so r must be maintained by hand here.

note: Liara / CTLSM2 - high-res ASLM (single-sided illumination, no galvo; voice-coil swept waist). These stage limits are the ONLY thing that gates a stage move: position_controller.move_x/y/z/r raise on violation and movement_controller._clamp_to_limits clamps. microscope_hardware.yaml's stage_limits block is a tile-count estimate only, and ScopeSettings.txt's own limits are enforced by the server, not read by this app. Liara's scope Home is x 2.820, y 3.377, z 12.167, r -95.012 - recorded here for reference ONLY. It is deliberately NOT written as reference_position: Home is rewritten by the vendor control software without our knowledge, so it is not a vetted recovery anchor. Leave reference_position absent (Go To Reference Position will correctly refuse) until someone records a high, central, objective-clear position at the instrument via Edit > Microscope Setup.
